questions.question: If 'DONKEY' is coded as '88' and 'SPARROW' is coded as '79', then how will 'PEGION' be coded?
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

**Logic: Addition of opposite value of given words = Number code**

'DONKEY' is coded as '88'

Addition of opposite value → 23 + 12 + 13 + 16 + 22 + 2 = **'****88'**

Addition of opposite value → 8 + 11 + 26 + 9 + 9 + 12 + 4 = **'79'**

Similarly,

'PEGION' is coded as '?'

Hence, the correct answer is **"96".**

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow (s) from the statements.

**Statements**:

Some chairs are windows.

all windows are boards.

**Conclusions**:

I. All chairs are boards.

II. All boards are windows.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2385a164cfebad1a368f84c719d8f7ec17e93c1317a5c7c48aaa226d8ffb3c22.png] 

I) All chairs are boards → Does not follow → As all windows are board and some chairs are windows. So all chairs are boards it can be possible but not definite.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9598cf8fcf01c542bce02c991079023bbeade7c5b666d11cab4552e90806874e.png] 

II) All boards are windows → Does not follow → As all windows are boards, So all boards cannot be windows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Neither conclusion I nor II follows".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the numbers of the following set.

(12, 30, 204)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

(12, 30, 204): 12² + 30 × 2 = 144 + 60 = 204.

Similarly, (15, 20, 265): 152 + 20 × 2 = 225 + 40 = 265.

Hence, (15, 20, 265) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the number-pair in which the two numbers are related in the same way as the two numbers of the following number-pair.

6 ∶ 85
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Number : Number² + (Number + 1)²**

⇒ 6 : 85

⇒ 6 : 6² + (6 + 1)²

⇒ 6 : 6² + 7²

⇒ 6 : 36 + 49

⇒ 6 : 85

Similarly,

⇒ 9 : 181

⇒ 9 : 9² + (9 + 1)²

⇒ 9 : 9² + 10²

⇒ 9 : 81 + 100

**⇒ 9 : 181**

Hence, the correct answer is** "9 : 181".**
